camel_example: aliyun esa ListAsyncTasks --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --ResourceIds 408000003752512 --PageNumber 1 --TaskType free_cert --ResourceType site --TaskStatus success
description_en: Queries the list of asynchronous tasks. You can use this operation to query the status of asynchronous tasks triggered by users, such as free certificate applications
description_zh: 查询异步任务列表接口，用户触发的异步任务，如免费证书申请，可以通过此接口查询任务状态
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-async-tasks --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --resource-type site --resource-ids 408000003752512 --task-status success --task-type free_cert --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAsyncTasks

parameters.help_en: The number of tasks to display per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The resource ID to which the task belongs, such as a site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务所归属的资源id，如站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The current status of the task. Valid values:

in_progress: in progress.
success: completed.
fail: failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务当前的状态：

in_progress：进行中
success：完成
fail：失败
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: The task type. For example, the task type for applying for a free certificate is free_cert
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，如申请免费证书为：free_cert
parameters.name: task_type
